name: Yuanyuan Hu
title: PhD Student, Cognitive Neuroscience
affiliation: State Key Laboratory of Cognitive Science and Mental Health, Institute of Psychology, Chinese Academy of Sciences
profile: I study how genetic and environmental influences shape individual differences in brain structure and networks, with a focus on anxiety, depression, self-regulation, and transdiagnostic mental-health risk. My work combines twin designs, structural and functional neuroimaging, behavioral genetics, normative modeling, and connectome-based analyses.
positioningOptions: Genetically informed structural and multimodal neuroimaging of affective psychopathology.
Twin neuroimaging of anxiety, depression, and self-regulation.
Behavioral genetics of individual differences in brain structure and mental health.
Connectome-based analysis as a complementary direction.

education.institution: Institute of Psychology, Chinese Academy of Sciences
education.detail: Using twin data to investigate the brain mechanisms through which genetic and environmental factors influence mental health.

education.institution: Institute of Psychology, Chinese Academy of Sciences
education.detail: Using computational modelling and experimental psychology to study behavioural decision-making.

skills: Twin-based ACE and multivariate genetic modeling.
Structural MRI, resting-state fMRI, connectome, and network analysis.
Normative modeling, representational similarity analysis, spatial-null inference, and reproducible workflows in Python, MATLAB, and R.
